description: Calling an undefined function in a one-letter namespace is an evaluation error
notes: The spec has no namespaced function names, so n::f() would be a syntax error. hashicorp/hcl parses the call (finishParsingFunctionCall in hclsyntax/parser.go) and reports the unknown function during evaluation (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), naming the namespace it took from the name.
reference_error: There are no functions in namespace "n::"
